registration.proof: UniversalTraits/media/registries.lua:267 assigns UTTraitsRegistries.UT_alcoholic_II from CharacterTrait.register("UniversalTraits:UT_alcoholic_II"); the exact ID agrees with the runtime constant and definition.
registration.positive_path: Evaluate registries.lua and register the fully qualified ID before the definition is parsed.
registration.negative_path: An absent registration or different namespace makes UTCore.hasTrait unable to resolve the CharacterTrait and returns false.

definition_parser.proof: UniversalTraits/media/scripts/UT_character_traits.txt:1885-1894 contains one complete block with IsProfessionTrait=false, DisabledInMultiplayer=true, matching CharacterTrait, Cost=-7, both UI keys, and tier-I/tier-III exclusions. CharacterTraitDefinitionScript.java:30-106 parses these exact fields and calls addCharacterTraitDefinition/addMutuallyExclusive, but no live ScriptManager load was observed.
definition_parser.positive_path: Parse the exact block and materialize the II definition with cost -7, its two UI keys, no XP/grants, and the two listed alcoholic-tier exclusions.
definition_parser.negative_path: A missing CharacterTrait, unresolved exclusion token, or malformed field must not be credited as a fully materialized definition.
definition_parser.exact_proof_needed: A BuildID 23504596 startup/ScriptManager trace showing this exact block loaded without warning and with both listed exclusions resolved non-null.

namespace.proof: Registration, definition CharacterTrait, runtime TRAIT_ID, test carrier ID, and selected ledger all use UniversalTraits:UT_alcoholic_II; UIName and UIDescription consistently use UI_UT_alcoholic_II and UI_UT_alcoholic_IIDesc.
namespace.positive_path: Resolve the same fully qualified trait through registration, definition parsing, UTCore.hasTrait, and the runtime handler.
namespace.negative_path: Changing any site to an unqualified or differently cased ID prevents exact registry/trait membership agreement.

cost_xp_grants_exclusions.proof: The selected ledger correctly proves Cost=-7, no XPBoosts, no GrantedTraits, and reciprocal tier-I/tier-III exclusions. However UT_MET.lua:75-80 declares AlcoholDetox as Iron Liver plus all three alcoholic tiers, while this selected definition at UT_character_traits.txt:1893 excludes only I and III. Project guidance states UT_MET is reference-only and script addMutuallyExclusive is one-way, so selection-time II-versus-Iron-Liver exclusion is absent from the II side.
cost_xp_grants_exclusions.positive_path: Selecting II excludes alcoholic I and III through the two explicit definition entries; the selected ledger's deterministic reverse scan proves those tier exclusions exist and are reciprocal.
cost_xp_grants_exclusions.negative_path: Select II before Iron Liver: this definition supplies no Iron Liver exclusion, and UT_MET cannot populate the character-creation UI, so bidirectional Iron Liver exclusion cannot be inferred from the group or the opposite trait alone.
cost_xp_grants_exclusions.exact_proof_needed: After an authorized product correction, directly verify both script definitions list one another and run two character-creation cases: II then Iron Liver and Iron Liver then II. No correction is authorized in this audit.

source_intent.proof: The current trait comment describes moderate craving causing stress when sober; English UI.json:341 states INTOXICATION below 5, +0.10 STRESS, every ten in-game minutes; UT_alcoholic_II.lua:6-16 implements precisely that current product intent without panic or a persistent withdrawal timer.
source_intent.positive_path: At intoxication 4 and stress 0.20, one ten-minute dispatch yields stress 0.30.
source_intent.negative_path: At intoxication exactly 5, stress is unchanged; no panic, trait mutation, or timer write occurs.
source_intent.historical_boundary: No upstream source-mod commit/tag was supplied, so historical equivalence is not claimed.

runtime_path.proof: UT_alcoholic_II.lua:6-16 registers handler on Events.EveryTenMinutes; handler gets the local player, exits on nil, exits when UTCore.hasTrait is false, gets Stats, reads CharacterStat.INTOXICATION, and conditionally read-modify-writes CharacterStat.STRESS.
runtime_path.positive_path: Valid carrier -> Stats -> INTOXICATION<5 -> STRESS=min(1, old+0.10).
runtime_path.negative_path: Nil player, non-carrier, or INTOXICATION>=5 exits without a Stats write.

numbers.proof: The code uses strict INTOXICATION < 5 and STRESS math.min(1, old+0.10). CharacterStat.java:21/29 defines INTOXICATION 0..100 and STRESS 0..1; Stats.java:74-82 independently clamps set values.
numbers.negative_path: INTOXICATION 5 leaves 0.89 unchanged; qualifying STRESS 0.95 becomes 1.0, not 1.05.

cadence.proof: The sole subscription is Events.EveryTenMinutes and there is no secondary counter or modulo gate. GameTime.java:729-733 emits zero-argument EveryTenMinutes at ten-minute boundaries, giving six handler attempts per in-game hour.
cadence.positive_path: Each producer dispatch can apply one +0.10 stress transformation to an eligible carrier.
cadence.negative_path: GameTime.java:737-739 emits EveryOneMinute separately; a non-ten-minute minute boundary does not invoke this handler.

cooldown.proof: The trait module contains no timestamp, counter, modData, elapsed-time read, or cooldown branch; EveryTenMinutes is the only limiter.
cooldown.positive_path: Two producer dispatches cause two independent eligible transformations.
cooldown.negative_path: Elapsed wall time or world age alone cannot call this module without the subscribed event dispatch.

reset_save_load.proof: The trait owns no persisted state. Stats.java:34-55 loads/saves every ORDERED_STATS value, including INTOXICATION and STRESS; IsoGameCharacter.java:6029-6034 calls Stats.save. UTCore_API.lua invalidates per-player trait-result cache when player identity changes. No current-version live save/reload trace was supplied.
reset_save_load.positive_path: Save INTOXICATION 4/STRESS 0.20, reload current version into a new player object, recompute the trait result, then one event should yield 0.30.
reset_save_load.negative_path: Save INTOXICATION 5/STRESS 0.20, reload, and one event should leave 0.20; no II-owned modData key should appear.
reset_save_load.exact_proof_needed: A BuildID 23504596 full-exit/relaunch current-version save/load trace proving preserved Stats, player-cache invalidation, exactly one callback, and exactly one post-load delta. Backward migration is explicitly out of scope.

java_lua.proof: LuaManager.java:3558-3561 exposes global getPlayer():IsoPlayer; UTCore.hasTrait validates IsoGameCharacter, resolves ResourceLocation/CharacterTrait, and calls player:hasTrait; IsoGameCharacter.java:4338-4340 returns Stats and :6236-6238 accepts CharacterTrait; Stats.java:74-82 exposes get/set(CharacterStat,float). Receiver and argument chains are exact in source, but live Kahlua overload binding was not observed.
java_lua.positive_path: getPlayer returns IsoPlayer; UTCore resolves the namespaced CharacterTrait; getStats returns Stats; get/set receive CharacterStat.INTOXICATION/STRESS and numeric values.
java_lua.negative_path: Nil/non-IsoGameCharacter exits; a string stat key, legacy named getter/setter, unresolved ResourceLocation, or wrong receiver is not equivalent to the exact bridge path.
java_lua.exact_proof_needed: A live BuildID 23504596 Kahlua trace proving global/class exposure and overload binding for getPlayer, CharacterTrait resolution, hasTrait, getStats, Stats.get, and Stats.set.

kahlua.proof: The module uses only locals, a closure, if/return/not, colon calls, table constants, numeric comparison/addition, math.min, and Events.Add. It uses no goto, Java collection indexing, pcall, iterator, or unsupported syntax; standard-Lua loading and mocks are not live Kahlua proof.
kahlua.positive_path: Load the module with UTCore, CharacterStat, math, getPlayer, and Events.EveryTenMinutes exposed, then dispatch the stored closure.
kahlua.negative_path: Remove CharacterStat or the event table to distinguish parser compatibility from required runtime-global availability; nil player and absent trait remain safe exits.
kahlua.exact_proof_needed: A full desktop relaunch followed by successful module load and one live dispatch without a Kahlua dialog or log exception.

events.proof: GameTime.java:729-733 produces zero-argument EveryTenMinutes; UT_alcoholic_II.lua:16 adds one local closure and never removes it. The prior ledger's claim of single-shot require caching is rejected: project guidance says PZ loads via dofile, and the test suite also uses dofile. No idempotence key or Remove guard exists.
events.positive_path: Evaluate the trait file once in a clean process, cross one ten-minute boundary, and observe one zero-argument callback.
events.negative_path: Evaluate the file twice: two distinct local closures are added, so one producer event can apply two deltas.
events.exact_proof_needed: A current-build full-exit/relaunch and repeated-world-entry trace proving the loader evaluates this file exactly once per relevant lifecycle and that only one listener remains registered.

stacking_interactions.proof: The handler performs a sequential read-modify-write on shared STRESS and clamps at 1.0. Tier I/III coexistence is prevented by explicit reciprocal definitions per selected ledger evidence. UT_MET groups Iron Liver with the tiers but supplies no runtime enforcement; II-side Iron Liver selection exclusion is missing. No other trait implementation was read.
stacking_interactions.positive_path: With any external STRESS writer before this listener, II reads the resulting value and adds 0.10 up to 1.0; normal tier-I/III selection is rejected in both directions.
stacking_interactions.negative_path: Forced coexistence or another listener changes STRESS sequentially in event order; at cap II contributes no further value. Iron Liver coexistence cannot be ruled out from II's definition.
stacking_interactions.exact_proof_needed: Targeted current-build tests for II/I and II/III both selection orders, II/Iron-Liver both selection orders, and representative shared-STRESS listener orders. Broad all-trait analysis is outside this artifact.

multiplayer.proof: UT_character_traits.txt:1888 sets DisabledInMultiplayer=true. The user and project contract define multiplayer support, synchronization, migration, proof, tests, and documentation as non-goals; the flag proves only a selection restriction.
multiplayer.positive_path: Parse and expose DisabledInMultiplayer=true so the supported selection path can exclude the trait in multiplayer.
multiplayer.negative_path: No synchronization or multiplayer execution guarantee is inferred from the metadata.

display.proof: The definition assigns UIName=UI_UT_alcoholic_II and English UI.json:340 maps that exact key to Alcoholic II.
display.positive_path: Resolve UIName through EN/UI.json and obtain Alcoholic II.
display.negative_path: Resolve UI_UT_alcoholic_IIDesc instead and obtain the distinct description string.

description.proof: English UI.json:341 says intoxication below 5 causes +0.10 stress every ten in-game minutes; the runtime uses strict <5, +0.10, math.min(1), and EveryTenMinutes with no secondary throttle.
description.positive_path: At intoxication 0, one event increases stress by 0.10 subject to the 1.0 cap.
description.negative_path: At intoxication exactly 5 or higher, no increase occurs, matching the word below.

localization.proof: English UI.json:340-341 contains both exact assigned keys. The selected closed-world ledger states no owned non-English Translate locale files exist; no non-English entries or runtime fallback trace were available.
localization.positive_path: English lookup resolves both name and description.
localization.negative_path: Request an owned non-English entry for either key and the selected inventory has none.
localization.exact_proof_needed: Supply entries for each supported locale and verify Translator resolution, or explicitly approve English-only localization as a product non-goal.

balance.proof: Cost=-7 trades against up to +0.10 STRESS per sober ten minutes: six eligible dispatches produce +0.60 per game hour before the 1.0 cap, and ten eligible dispatches take stress from zero to cap. No gameplay telemetry defines whether this burden is fair.
balance.positive_path: Simulate six eligible transformations from zero to obtain STRESS 0.60 and compare observed burden against seven granted points.
balance.negative_path: Starting at STRESS 0.95 realizes only +0.05, disproving a constant realized hourly penalty near saturation.
balance.exact_proof_needed: Matched current-build playtests measuring sober fraction, stress area-under-curve, alcohol use, and outcomes against no trait under a declared -7-point acceptance criterion.

performance.proof: Static cost is O(1) at six callbacks per game hour: player lookup and cached trait check on all paths; an owner adds getStats and one intoxication read; only a sober owner adds stress get/set. No loop or trait-owned growing state exists, but callback multiplication and live cost were not profiled.
performance.positive_path: For H game hours a single listener performs 6H bounded attempts with constant trait-local memory.
performance.negative_path: Non-carriers do no Stats work and intoxication>=5 performs no stress read/write; duplicate module evaluation would multiply the otherwise constant work.
performance.exact_proof_needed: An in-game profiler capture on BuildID 23504596 proving one listener, expected call counts, and no allocation/cost growth across reloads.

tests.proof: run_tests.lua:3391-3400 has one positive event test and one intoxication>=5 negative test. The positive assertion checks only STRESS>0, and the negative uses intoxication 10 rather than the exact boundary. No exact +0.10, cap, nil-player, absent-trait, repeated cadence, reload, or duplicate-registration test exists in the inspected cases.
tests.positive_path: The current positive fails if sober execution never raises stress; the current negative fails if intoxication 10 still mutates stress.
tests.negative_path: An implementation adding any positive amount can pass; a faulty <=5 comparison can pass because equality 5 is not tested; ungated non-carrier mutation and overflow are also unchallenged.
tests.exact_proof_needed: Add exact delta, equality-5, cap, nil-player, non-carrier, consecutive-event, and duplicate-load fixtures, plus separate current-version live save/reload proof. Tests were not run by instruction.

mocks.proof: UTTestMocks.lua:85-112 models generic CharacterStat get/set and :1547-1580 supplies correct INTOXICATION 0..100 and STRESS 0..1 metadata; :1274-1284 stores and fires EveryTenMinutes handlers. However mock Stats.set neither clamps nor returns Stats.set's real boolean, and event fire accepts arbitrary payload arguments.
mocks.positive_path: MockPlayer supplies the carrier and Stats receiver; the event stores the real closure and zero-argument fire exercises the consumer path.
mocks.negative_path: A production regression relying on Stats.set clamping/return value or an incorrect event payload can pass because set merely assigns and fire is variadic.
mocks.exact_proof_needed: Make mock Stats.set clamp via CharacterStat and return whether the value changed, and add a producer-contract fixture that rejects a handler depending on EveryTenMinutes payload arguments.

findings.summary: The AlcoholDetox reference group includes Iron Liver, but UT_alcoholic_II does not explicitly exclude Iron Liver, so selection-time exclusivity is not bidirectional from this trait's side.

Tests prove only a positive movement and intoxication-10 suppression; exact amount, equality boundary, cap, negative gates, duplicate load, real Stats.set behavior, event signature, and save/reload remain uncovered.
Both English keys exist, but the selected closed-world inventory contains no owned non-English locale entries.
poster.png is missing from the source root and both required UniversalTraits package levels.
